answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake bond tied to a track record. Before an agent can offer services, it locks a deposit that is slashed if peers prove fraud or duplicate identities. A lone honest agent pays this cost once, but a sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so creating thousands of copies becomes prohibitively expensive. Like an oasis that offers nectar only to travellers who first dig a well, the market rewards contributors who invest real resources, while hollow identities with no stake earn no trust and are ignored by reputation-weighted matching.
